senses.gloss:
द्वेष, अस्, m. (opposed to राग, काम, इच्छा),
hatred, hate, dislike, abhorrence; repugnance; malig-
nity, enmity; [cf. अ-द्˚ and तुलसी-द्˚.]

द्वेषण, अस्, आ, अम्, hating, disliking, inimical,
hostile; (अस्), m. an enemy; (अम्), n. hate, hatred
against (with gen.), enmity, dislike.
द्वेषणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be hated.

द्वेषस्, अस्, n., Ved. dislike, hatred, hostility; a
mischievous man, an enemy; [cf. अ-द्˚, तरद्-द्˚,
रक्षस्.]
—द्वेषो-युत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. removing hos-
tility, remover of sin; (Sāy.) filled with hatred.

द्वेषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, hating, disliking, hostile, inimi-
cal; (ई), m. a hater, foe, an enemy; [cf. क्रिया-द्˚
and गजासुर-द्˚.]
—द्वेषि-द्वेष-पर, अस्, आ,
अम्, filled with hatred towards enemies.

द्वेष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, one who hates, a hater,
disliking, hating, inimical, an enemy, foe.
—द्वेष्-
टृ-त्व, अम्, n. hatred, hostility.

द्वेष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be hated; disagreeable,
hateful, odious, detestable; (अस्), m. an enemy, a
foe.
—द्वेष्य-ता, f. aversion, dislike, disfavour;
odiousness, detestableness.

द्वेसत द्वेसत, अस्, आ, अम्, having the same
length above and below the navel; (also read द्व-
यसत.)
